listen_host.description: IP address for the proxy to listen on.

listen_port.description: Local port used for accepting the proxy connection.

connect_host.description: Name or IP of host that the proxy will connect to.

connect_port.description: Remote port used for the connection.

mode.description: Operating mode: 'client' for X client side, 'server' for X server side.

log_level.description: Log level: 0 for FATAL, 1 for ERROR, 2 for WARNING, 3 for INFO, 4 for DEBUG.

log_file.description: Name of the log file. Empty or default implies stderr.

log_format.description: Log format string (e.g., '0' for plain text, 'u' for time, 'l' for level).

link.description: Link speed indication (modem, isdn, adsl, wan, lan, local) or bandwidth spec.

type.description: Type of session (e.g., windows, unix-kde, unix-application).

loopback.description: Bind to the loopback device only.

accept.description: Name or IP of host that can connect to the proxy. Empty implies all.

nodelay.description: Set TCP_NODELAY on the proxy link.

render.description: Enable or disable use of the RENDER extension.

cache.description: Size of the in-memory X message cache. 0 disables.

timeout.description: Keep-alive timeout in seconds. 0 disables check.

encryption.description: Set to 1 if the proxy is part of a program providing encryption.
